case_title.quote: SHAJAHAN v. STATE REP. BY INSPECTOR OF POLICE
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment header.

number_of_accused.quote: the trial court convicted all the five accused
number_of_accused.reason: Five accused are stated in the judgment.

accused_gender.quote: from his house at Pudupet in Vridhachalam
accused_gender.reason: All accused are referred to with male names and pronouns; no female accused appears, so 'Mixed' is contradicted.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not stated.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: deceased Muthukrishnan who was sleeping inside the shop
victim_gender.reason: Deceased is male, referred to with 'his' throughout.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: Muthukrishnan who was sleeping inside the shop
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment does not describe any relationship; 'Stranger' is an inference not stated.

offence_category.quote: with common intention to commit robbery in a Pawn Broking shop
offence_category.reason: Robbery/dacoity with murder matches the judgment's offence.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.396 r/w s.34 (also charged under ss.457, 395, 302 r/w 34 and FIR under ss.457, 380, 302)
statutory_provisions.reason: Conviction is under s.396 r/w s.34, but other charged sections are omitted.

weapon.correct_value: Jute rope used to strangle deceased; accused were not armed
weapon.quote: tied the jute rope around the neck of Muthukrishnan
weapon.reason: Value says no weapon, but a jute rope was used for strangulation.

evidence_type.correct_value: Oral witness testimony, recovery, confessions, identification by owner, documentary registers of pawn shop
evidence_type.quote: corroborated by the registers maintained in his Pawn shop
evidence_type.reason: Omits oral eyewitness-type testimony, identification and documentary registers; 'circumstantial' is not stated.

confession.quote: Based on the confession statements of accused Basheer and Shajahan, jewels kept in the cover
confession.reason: Each listed confession is stated to have led to recoveries.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: the offence under Section 396 IPC is to be viewed with seriousness
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Murder during dacoity is the aggravating feature the court highlights.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: But in the case in hand, the accused were not armed.
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court relies on non-use of arms and long lapse of time.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted all the five accused inter alia under Section 396 IPC read with Section 34 IPC and sentenced them to undergo rigorous imprisonment for ten years
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court conviction and sentence.

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court enhanced the sentence of imprisonment from ten years to imprisonment for life
high_court_outcome.reason: Conviction upheld and sentence enhanced to life, as stated.

final_outcome.correct_value: Conviction under s.396 r/w s.34 maintained; sentence reduced to ten years; appellants ordered released
final_outcome.quote: While maintaining the conviction under Section 396 IPC, the sentence
final_outcome.reason: 'Convicted' is right but omits the sentence reduction and release order.

offence_finally_established.quote: Section 396 IPC prescribes punishment for dacoity with murder.
offence_finally_established.reason: Dacoity with murder is the established offence.

imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced them to undergo rigorous imprisonment for ten years
imprisonment_type.reason: Fixed-term rigorous imprisonment of ten years is stated.

imprisonment_years.quote: the sentence of imprisonment for life is modified as ten years

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Chellam (PW-4), a sweeper at the pawn shop, informed the owner PW-1 that the deceased was found dead.
neutral_facts.quote: Chellam-PW-4 employed as the sweeper at the Pawn shop came to the house of PW-1
neutral_facts.reason: Says deceased's brother discovered body; judgment names sweeper Chellam (PW-4) informing owner PW-1.

offence_severity.reason: Section 396 sentencing options are death or life imprisonment, as stated.

attempt_completion.quote: other accused robbed jewellery about 4.788 kg. of gold

physical_harm.correct_value: Deceased strangled to death; A4 is alleged to have sat on him and tightened a rope around his neck
physical_harm.quote: Babu @ Nawab Sahib (A4) is alleged to have sat on his chest
physical_harm.reason: Judgment presents A4's strangling as an allegation, not an established fact.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence: s.396 r/w s.34 (dacoity with murder), committed by five accused; conviction maintained
number_of_offences.quote: convicted all the five accused inter alia under Section 396 IPC read with Section 34 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Value confuses accused count with offences; only s.396 conviction was maintained, not 'five offences'.

financial_property_loss.reason: Loss of about Rs.12,00,000 in gold and silver matches.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation or planning is not expressly stated beyond common intention.

motive.correct_value: Robbery of jewellery from the pawn shop (common intention to commit robbery)
motive.quote: with common intention to commit robbery in a Pawn Broking shop
motive.reason: Judgment states the motive as robbery of the pawn shop, not unidentified.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: There is clear and cogent evidence against accused Raja Mohammad and Babu @ Nawab Sahib
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the court's acceptance of PW-15, PW-17 and recoveries.

witness_credibility.quote: evidence of PWs 21 and 22 is to be read along with the evidence of Investigating Officer (PW-37)
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the court's treatment of hostile witnesses and PW-37.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Basheer and Shajahan ran when intercepted by police and were caught
post_offence_conduct.quote: the appellants started running and the police caught hold of them
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment states the accused fled on interception, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.quote: the appellants are stated to be in custody for more than ten years
custody_duration.reason: Custody of more than ten years is stated.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 13/14.11.2002; High Court judgment: 03.09.2010; Supreme Court decision: 16.02.2018; trial judgment date not stated
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment and Order dated 03.09.2010 of the High Court of Madras
trial_duration.reason: 03.09.2010 is the High Court judgment date, not the trial judgment; High Court date is mislabelled as not stated.

legal_representation.quote: Amit Kumar, R. Balasubramanian, B. Karunakaran
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondent match.

investigation_status.quote: chargesheet was filed against the accused under Sections 457, 395, 396 and 302 read with 34 IPC

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.quote: the High Court enhanced the sentence of imprisonment from ten years to imprisonment for life
appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution case: accused committed robbery in pawn shop; A4 strangled sleeping deceased; jewels recovered via confessions; no separate arguments recorded
prosecution_argument.quote: with common intention to commit robbery in a Pawn Broking shop
prosecution_argument.reason: Restates trial outcomes rather than prosecution arguments; the judgment records no separate prosecution arguments.

defence_argument.reason: Defence arguments are not recorded in the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.quote: all his companions who are conjointly committing dacoity, are liable to be convicted under Section 396 IPC
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the court's stated principle on constructive liability under s.396.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Dinesh alias Buddha v. State of Rajasthan (2006) 3 SCC 771 was relied on by the High Court; the Supreme Court only referred to it
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Placing reliance upon Dinesh alias Buddha v. State of Rajasthan
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Citation is correct, but it was the High Court's reliance, not the Supreme Court's.

sentencing_rationale.quote: Considering the long lapse of time and the facts and circumstances of the case, the sentence of imprisonment for life is modified as ten years
sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale matches the court's stated reasoning.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: Considering the long lapse of time and the facts and circumstances of the case
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Long lapse of time and case facts are cited as mitigating.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: The offence under Section 396 IPC is to be viewed with seriousness
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are expressly listed; the court only stresses seriousness.

other_sentence_order.quote: the appellants are ordered to be released forthwith, if not required in any other case
